analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing compatibility challenges when programming newer hardware models with older or even current software releases. The platform does not offer clear steps beyond a basic error message, resulting in uncertainty about which software version and upgrade path is required.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to be compatible with the latest hardware revisions or to provide straightforward instructions for updating and resolving compatibility issues.
